extDescription.message: Fill saved logins from the Kagisecure Mac app into web pages. Requires the Kagisecure app for macOS; does nothing on its own.

extDescriptionSafari.message: Fill logins from your Kagisecure vault. Values never leave the app until you approve a fill.

popupChecking.description: Popup status before the first answer.

popupForget.description: Button that forgets the item chosen for this tab.

continuingAs.description: $1 is a username or item title.

emptyOpenAndUnlock.message: Open Kagisecure and unlock your vault.

emptyUnlockToSee.message: Unlock Kagisecure to see what applies to this page.

autofillNotOnPage.message: Autofill does not run on this page.

noItemForPage.message: No item is saved for this page.

fillFailed.message: Kagisecure could not fill this page.

totpApplied.message: One-time code applied. It expires in under a minute.

openFromApplications.message: Open Kagisecure from your Applications folder or the menu bar, and unlock it.

fillWithKagisecure.description: Accessible label of the in-page icon.

noItemForSite.message: No kagisecure item is saved for this site.

totpCopied.message: One-time code copied. It expires in under a minute.

totpCopyFailed.message: Could not copy the code. Open Kagisecure and copy it there.

errLocked.message: Kagisecure is locked. Unlock it and try again.

errTimeout.message: Nobody answered the approval in Kagisecure.

errOriginMismatch.message: That item is not saved for this site, so kagisecure refused to fill it.

errUnknownConnection.message: Kagisecure does not recognize this browser connection. Re-run setup in the app.

errAuditUnavailable.message: Kagisecure could not save this fill to its audit log, so nothing was filled. Open Kagisecure to see why, then try again.

errConflict.message: Kagisecure needs your attention to continue. Open Kagisecure to resolve it.

noUsableOrigin.message: This page has no usable origin.

detailTimeout.message: kagisecure did not answer in time.

detailSafariNotConnected.message: Kagisecure is not running, or its Safari extension is not connected.
